text: In accordance with city-wide residential demolition control under Article II, Demolition Control, of Municipal Code Ch. 363, as amended by By-law No. 1009-2006, enacted by City Council on September 27, 2006 under the authority of Section 33 of the Planning Act, I refer the demolition application for 14 Indian Grove (Application No. 18-148695 DEM) to Toronto and East York Community Council for consideration and to decide whether to grant or refuse the application, including any conditions, if any, to be attached to the permit application. This staff report is regarding a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Refused the application to demolish the subject detached single family dwelling at 14 Indian Grove because there is no permit for a replacement building issued on this site.
